searchText: To EIP editors, what would you recommend as author list for an EIP derived from a wide research effort with contributions from multiple researchers and cryptographers? This is a consensus layer only EIP that summarizes this etheresearch post https://ethresear.ch/t/whisk-a-practical-shuffle-based-ssle-protocol-for-ethereum/11763 , EIP pre-draft: https://github.com/dapplion/EIPs/pull/1 Note that the etheresearch post is meant to remain as the complete and canonical source of EIP background, rationale and security considerations. authors are generally people responsible to maintain the EIP and doesn't reflect the `credits` list (if that is the concern) is the credits list a field in the EIP? i don't think so, may be it can be added
